newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CPMF tax rules due out Friday - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CPMF tax rules due out Friday - newspaper.

text.p: Brazil's government is due to reveal on Friday rules for a new financial transaction tax which will take effect on January 25 but it has not yet decided whether stock trades will be exempt, newspapers said.

Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said the government is likely to allow foreign investors in local stocks to be partially exempt by charging the 0.2 percent tax only when the money comes in and is sent abroad after the shares are sold.
Newspapers said a final decision had been delayed because the Finance and Health ministries disagree over the exemptions.
The CPMF tax will provide some $400 million a month to the Health Ministry.
